acceptance: Encrypted settings exclude raw secrets from shared caches; emergency source-UI restoration works on crash and downgrade.

positive.fixture: sealed per-origin preferences round trip and drive the renderer; restore on crash and downgrade

negative.fixture: planted secret never appears in storage, impostor origin and foreign-version records are never read or deleted, unreadable settings render defaults

versions.primitive: no primitive change; wasm ABI 4, protocol vsf-ext-v1, pairing and session endpoints v1

security_and_source_permissions: AES-GCM with a non-extractable key; record name is AAD; strict closed-vocabulary parser.
known_limitations: Key lives in the browser profile; a profile compromise exposes sealed values
